E2967

Frame resource schedule refused: {detail}

What

Frame resource schedule refused: {detail}

Why

The scheduler derives dependencies, transfers, lifetimes, and reuse only from checked access and completion facts; an unresolved alias or completion would make execution unsafe.

Fix

Preserve source order, declare the complete resource access, or provide the real completion event before requesting parallel execution.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E2967: tests/ui/resource_schedule_conflict.stderr.
